title: Young employees agree that AI...
fullPassage: Young employees agree that AI has more positive impact with the dynamics of the workplace. But while these employees may embrace AI's assistance with a number of tasks, it would be misleading to label them as entirely trusting of its capabilities. Even the most tech-savvy millennials, who seamlessly engage with AI tools, tend to draw a line at allowing it to make final decisions in critical areas like hiring and performance reviews. Similarly, across generations, workers express a desire for a harmonious integration of AI, one that enhances rather than replaces human judgment. This balance is reflected in workers' preferences for AI to assist with data analysis, draft creation, and information research, while they resist its involvement in areas where empathy, ethical judgment, and personal understanding are required. Looking at the bigger picture, what's emerging is not a simple narrative of AI as savior or threat, but rather a complex landscape where the value of AI is recognized alongside an awareness of its limitations.
